questions.q: What was Nehemiah's work for the king?
questions.evidence: Now I was cup bearer to the king

questions.q: In the twentieth year of which king did Nehemiah bring him wine?
questions.evidence: In the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, I picked up the wine, and gave it to the king

questions.q: What did the wall builders hold in one hand while they worked with the other?
questions.evidence: everyone with one of his hands did the work, and with the other held his weapon

questions.q: In how many days was the wall finished?
questions.evidence: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days

questions.q: Who read the book of the law to the people from early morning until midday?
questions.evidence: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month. He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday

questions.q: "Don't be grieved," Nehemiah said, "for the joy of Yahweh is your" what?
questions.evidence: Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength

questions.q: What did Nehemiah see men in Judah doing on the Sabbath?
questions.evidence: In those days saw I in Judah some men treading wine presses on the Sabbath, bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys
